body.statement: Theorem 2 (Quadratic oracle complexity).  If \(|V_0|=p\), \(\operatorname{RankPeel}\) returns either \(\bot\) or a graph after at most \(p^2+p\) membership-and-rank calls to the law-invariant oracle, \(O(p^3)\) elementary bookkeeping, \(O(p^2)\) graph storage, and at most \(1+\lfloor\log_2p\rfloor\) nonempty iterations.  On the query-local first-jet-determining, fibre-coherent strict subclass in Theorem 1, the run is complete and the returned graph is the identified adjacency target.  The polynomial bound is an algorithmic comparison with the exhaustive subset construction, not an unchanged-class strict-tightening claim.
body.justification: The oracle-call, bookkeeping, storage, and iteration budgets are execution properties; only their exact-recovery interpretation is subclass-restricted.
body.gap: This is no longer positioned as an unchanged-class strict tightening of the published theorem.
body.consumer: It bounds the family of population decisions that a later statistical procedure would need to calibrate.
